outcome: Preterm delivery (delivery before 37 completed weeks of gestation)
cohort: Women giving birth during the Day of Atonement and during the corresponding day a week earlier, between the years 1988 and 2011.
finding: A 25-hour fast during the Day of Atonement was an independent risk factor for preterm delivery among Jewish parturients (adjusted OR = 2.0; 95% CI, 1.03-3.83; p = 0.041).
